Application and no-DOM core configurations passed

finalChecks.result: Valid editable draft with explicit unresolved connection warnings

failureAndCorrectionHistory.failingTest: M1_editor: keeps text-field undo and deletion separate from map commands
failureAndCorrectionHistory.observed: The final map Undo was correctly blocked by the newly required unapplied-input confirmation; the legacy test expected the committed name immediately.
failureAndCorrectionHistory.correction: Added guard visibility, unchanged hash and still-pending name assertions, then explicit discard before retaining the original name-A assertion. No production change was needed for this test adaptation.

failureAndCorrectionHistory.run: Initial test-only patch and incomplete recheck
failureAndCorrectionHistory.observed: Text replacement initially matched an earlier unrelated Undo block, causing TS2304 and TS2339. The subsequent browser process was manually interrupted after three completed passing tests.
failureAndCorrectionHistory.correction: Restored the unrelated block and limited the six-line addition to the intended test. Re-ran typecheck and lint successfully before the final full browser run.

failureAndCorrectionHistory.independentReview: A separate core agent reviewed all legacy test diffs: original assertions retained, compatibility edits intentional, no remaining misplaced patch.

examples.generationMethod: Load the original M2A synthetic map through the shared pipeline, apply five domain commands including explicit schema upgrade, then serialize the valid map. The invalid file is a deliberate external JSON edit to one service node reference.
examples.provenanceLimit: Synthetic only; no measured speed, service duration, capacity, traffic execution or simulation events invented.

visualChecks.observed: Service target, facility, authoritative node and arrival declaration readable; unresolved attachment warning retained.
Unapplied-input modal title and both explicit decision buttons visible; no clipping.

additionalUiRegression: Before the final source freeze, long service-creation modal autofocus was changed to preventScroll. N02 asserts initial scrollTop is zero and the heading is in the viewport; it passed in both complete runs.
limitations: Browser automation ran only installed Chrome on Windows. Firefox and Safari were not run.
The retained local-file tests combine a simulated picker with real OPFS handles, reads, writes and close operations; they do not certify native OS permission prompts.
Quota, completion-delay and Object.freeze restore failures are explicitly simulated fault injections, not naturally occurring disk or quota failures.
Connection summaries remain blocked or unchecked. No fully validated reachable status, routing, task simulation or scheduler is delivered.
The JavaScript bundle size warning remains.
Labels for co-located spatial objects can overlap; this batch does not claim to solve label placement.
Raw traces, screenshots and .cache logs are local evidence, intentionally not included in the published source tree.
evidencePolicy: All paths are relative to paper01/map. Final unit/integration/build results refer to the frozen product source; after the legacy test-only correction, typecheck/lint and the entire browser suite were rerun. Interrupted runs are excluded from acceptance counts.
